title.zh: Ghostty作者的新终端Rex同时跑1万个会话，只占3.8GB内存
title.en: Ghostty作者的新终端Rex同时跑1万个会话，只占3.8GB内存

current_state.zh: Ghostty author Mitchell Hashimoto's new terminal Rex sustained 10,000 simultaneous sessions at roughly 3.8GB of memory, with the team detailing Linux file-descriptor-table and threading bottlenecks they patched, and a next target of 100,000 sessions.
